criterion.title: Todoist Focus Task Updates Main Widget
criterion.given: I click a task in the Todoist popup
criterion.then: - Main Todoist widget immediately updates to display the focused task - The "[WORKING]" text is removed (yellow highlight remains in popup only) - The popup automatically closes after selection - The focused task persists across Sketchybar restarts

criterion.title: Todoist Popup Opens Instantly (<100ms)
criterion.given: the Todoist precache system is running
criterion.when: I click the Todoist widget to open the popup
criterion.then: - Popup appears in under 100ms (instant feel) - Task data is current within the last 5 minutes - If cache is stale or missing, show "Refreshing tasks..." with loading icon - Precache runs automatically every 5 minutes via LaunchAgent

implementation.changes: - Create background precache script following calendar sync pattern - Fetch tasks from Todoist API with 30-second timeout - Parse JSON with Python (top 5 tasks, sorted by priority) - Write to ~/.cache/sketchybar/todoist_tasks_cache - Cache format: SYNC_STATUS=success|failed, TASKS_START, then pipe-delimited task lines - Comprehensive logging to logs/todoist-precache.log - Trigger todoist_synced custom event on success

- StartInterval: 300 seconds (5 minutes) - RunAtLoad: true (immediate first sync) - EnvironmentVariables: PATH with /opt/homebrew/bin (CRITICAL for Homebrew tools) - StandardOutPath/StandardErrorPath: logs for debugging

- Lines 52-61: Replace API call with cache read - Read SYNC_STATUS and TASKS from cache file - Handle missing cache: show "Refreshing tasks..." and trigger manual sync - Handle failed sync: show retry option - Remove Python parsing block (lines 63-101) - now done in precache script

criterion.title: Calendar Day Boundary Logic Works Correctly
criterion.given: various meeting scenarios throughout the day
criterion.then:
Scenario A: No meetings today, has tomorrow - Shows random FREE_DAY_MESSAGES (not tomorrow's countdown)
Scenario B: Had meetings today, all complete, has tomorrow - Shows random END_OF_DAY_MESSAGES
Scenario C: Has upcoming meeting today - Shows countdown timer to that meeting

implementation.changes: - Lines 92-104: Fix check_meetings_today() function - Simplified logic: khal list today today --format "{title}" - Return "had_meetings" if output non-empty, else "no_meetings" - After line 182: Add day boundary check in update_display_from_cache() - Extract MEETING_DATE from NEXT_MEETING - Compare with TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d) - If DATE != TODAY: call check_meetings_today() and show appropriate message - Preserve existing countdown logic for today's meetings (lines 190-230)

technical.constraint: Popup open time MUST be <100ms after precaching (down from 500-1000ms)

API timeout: 30 seconds prevents hanging on network issues
LaunchAgent MUST include EnvironmentVariables PATH with Homebrew paths (/opt/homebrew/bin)
Sync failures MUST NOT crash Sketchybar or prevent widget display
Graceful degradation: show cached data with "stale" indicator on failures

tests.standards:
Testing follows brownfield project patterns with manual verification and shell script-based tests.
Unit Testing: Individual functions tested in isolation (check_meetings_today, cache read/write, API calls)
Integration Testing: Full workflows tested end-to-end (precache → popup → focus → persist, calendar state transitions)
Performance Testing: Popup open speed measured with `time` command, targeting <100ms after precaching
Error Scenario Testing: Network failures, missing tokens, stale cache, invalid data gracefully handled
Each phase tested independently before proceeding to next phase. Manual testing with real Sketchybar environment.

locations.location: config/sketchybar/helpers/test-*.sh - Test scripts for individual components
Manual testing via Sketchybar UI - Click widgets, verify behavior, check logs
~/.config/sketchybar/logs/ - Runtime logs for debugging and verification

test.name: Test focus task file write and read
test.steps: 1. Write test task ID to ~/.cache/sketchybar/todoist_working_task 2. Trigger todoist_focus_changed event 3. Query todoist widget and verify label matches focused task

test.name: Test focus task persistence across restart
test.steps: 1. Select focus task via popup 2. Restart Sketchybar: brew services restart sketchybar 3. Verify widget still shows focused task (reads from cache)

test.name: Test precache script execution
test.steps: 1. Run: bash ~/.config/sketchybar/helpers/todoist-precache.sh 2. Verify cache file created: ~/.cache/sketchybar/todoist_tasks_cache 3. Verify log entry: tail -n 5 ~/.config/sketchybar/logs/todoist-precache.log 4. Verify cache format: SYNC_STATUS, TASKS_START, pipe-delimited lines

test.name: Measure popup open speed
test.steps: 1. Ensure cache is populated (run precache script) 2. Use time command: time (sketchybar --set todoist popup.drawing=on && sleep 0.1) 3. Verify total time <100ms 4. Compare with pre-optimization baseline (500-1000ms)

test.name: Test LaunchAgent periodic execution
test.steps: 1. Load LaunchAgent: launchctl load -w ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.todoist-precache.plist 2. Verify running: launchctl list | grep todoist-precache 3. Wait 5+ minutes, check cache modification time: ls -lh ~/.cache/sketchybar/todoist_tasks_cache 4. Verify logs show periodic sync: tail -f ~/.config/sketchybar/logs/todoist-precache.log

test.name: Test check_meetings_today function
test.steps: 1. Source meeting.sh: source ~/.config/sketchybar/plugins/meeting.sh 2. Call function: check_meetings_today 3. Verify returns "had_meetings" or "no_meetings" based on khal data 4. Test with known calendar states (empty day, past meetings, upcoming meetings)

test.name: Test calendar day boundary scenarios
test.steps:
Scenario A: No meetings today, has tomorrow 1. Clear today's calendar in khal 2. Add meeting for tomorrow 3. Trigger calendar sync 4. Verify widget shows FREE_DAY_MESSAGES (not tomorrow's countdown)
Scenario B: Had meetings today, all complete 1. Ensure today had meetings (check past events in khal) 2. Verify no upcoming meetings today 3. Trigger calendar sync 4. Verify widget shows END_OF_DAY_MESSAGES
Scenario C: Upcoming meeting today 1. Schedule meeting for later today 2. Trigger calendar sync 3. Verify widget shows countdown timer (not random message)

test.name: Test error scenarios
test.steps: 1. Missing API token: Rename .env, verify graceful failure with error message 2. API failure: Corrupt token, verify SYNC_STATUS=failed in cache 3. Stale cache: Delete cache file, verify "Refreshing tasks..." message 4. Network failure: Disconnect network, verify timeout and error logging

test.name: Verify no breaking changes to existing behavior
test.steps: 1. Test Todoist widget without focus task selected (should show highest priority) 2. Test calendar widget with meetings today (should show countdown) 3. Test popup display with API errors (should show error state) 4. Verify all other Sketchybar widgets still function normally
